The '''Priest House''' was a building located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fitsay]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]]. It was connected to the [[High Priest House]], the [[Audience Hall]], and the [[House of War]]. The ornate building was home to the [[Priests of the Sun]].<ref name="BGS" />
